# place supersedes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:placeSupersedes`](gmeow-placeSupersedes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/placeSupersedes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Links a newer place to a prior one it supersedes. Inverse of [`gmeow:placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md). Non-functional: one successor may consolidate several predecessors.
